info.name: Returns a single-level breakdown by a category or concept

params.name: source
params.description: The social media source name

params.name: account_ids
params.description: Comma separated list of account ids. Maximum: 10

params.name: metrics
params.description: Comma separated list of metric ids. Maximum: 10

params.name: start
params.description: The timestamp of the start of the time-range to query. An ISO8601 timestamp, excluding time and timezone/offset component. Example: 2022-01-01

params.name: end
params.description: The timestamp of the end of the time-range to query. An ISO8601 timestamp, excluding time and timezone/offset component. Example: 2021-01-28

params.name: company_id
params.description: Meltwater company id if running query on behalf of another company

items.docs: A 'breakdown' metric is an analysis that provides a single-level breakdown by a category or concept. For example, the `demographics_audience_country` metric breaks down the audience for a Facebook page by country. All timestamps in this endpoint work on PST timezone (Meta's preferred timezone).

items.docs: A 'heatmap' metric is an analysis that provides a break-down over date and time. For example, the `page_fans_heatmap` metric breaks down the audience for a Facebook page by how active they are each day and hour. All timestamps in this endpoint work on PST timezone (Meta's preferred timezone).

info.name: Allows to fetch the top posts for owned social accounts

params.name: source
params.description: The social media source name

params.name: account_ids
params.description: Comma separated list of account ids. Maximum: 10

params.name: metrics
params.description: Comma separated list of metric ids. Maximum: 10

params.name: start
params.description: The timestamp of the start of the time-range to query. An ISO8601 timestamp, excluding time and timezone/offset component. Example: 2022-01-01

params.name: end
params.description: The timestamp of the end of the time-range to query. An ISO8601 timestamp, excluding time and timezone/offset component. Example: 2021-01-28

params.name: company_id
params.description: Meltwater company id if running a query on behalf of another company

params.name: page
params.description: Used for paginating results

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of results to return per request

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Field on which the response will be sorted

params.name: sort_order
params.description: The sort order

params.name: post_types
params.description: The type of posts to retrieve

params.name: tag
params.description: Optional list of tags to filter the documents by

params.name: match_all_tags
params.description: If true, only documents with all tags provided will be returned

items.docs: Allows to fetch the top posts for owned social accounts. You might do this to report the most engaged with posts in a period of time for example. Timestamps in this endpoint for Facebook and Instagram sources work on PST timezone (Meta's preferred timezone).
